name: 寫入順序對調（先 x 後 y）
find:
w0001_wr16s(m, y_seg, y_off, y1);
    w0001_wr16s(m, x_seg, x_off, x1);
replace:
w0001_wr16s(m, x_seg, x_off, x1);
    w0001_wr16s(m, y_seg, y_off, y1);

name: x' 與 y' 寫反
find:
w0001_wr16s(m, y_seg, y_off, y1);
    w0001_wr16s(m, x_seg, x_off, x1);
replace:
w0001_wr16s(m, y_seg, y_off, x1);
    w0001_wr16s(m, x_seg, x_off, y1);

name: 回傳 y' 而非 x'
x 與 y 讀取對調
find:
uint16_t bx = w0001_rd16s(m, x_seg, x_off);
    uint16_t cx = w0001_rd16s(m, y_seg, y_off);
replace:
uint16_t bx = w0001_rd16s(m, y_seg, y_off);
    uint16_t cx = w0001_rd16s(m, x_seg, x_off);

name: 拿掉 ROM 區寫入無效的模型
讀 word 不在段內回繞(線性連續)
寫 word 不在段內回繞(線性連續)
replace:
w0001_put8(m, LIN(y_seg, y_off), (uint8_t)y1);
    w0001_put8(m, LIN(y_seg, y_off) + 1u, (uint8_t)(y1 >> 8));

name: 0062 與 0081 的 SI/DI 對調
find: uint16_t y1 = f_3A92_0081(m, si, di, bx, cx);
replace: uint16_t y1 = f_3A92_0081(m, di, si, bx, cx);

name: 0081 看到 0062 的結果當 x
find: uint16_t y1 = f_3A92_0081(m, si, di, bx, cx);
replace: uint16_t y1 = f_3A92_0081(m, si, di, x1, cx);
